contracts: Check the original battler's entire PP vector before accepting effects or exit.
Do not interpret a forced switch as selected-move replacement.
Accept a verified no-effect MAIN boundary after the last bounded settlement pulse.
Retain bounded phase, selection, observation, action and exception-location diagnostics.
An optional failure sink can persist diagnostics before outer exception handling.
Recorder failures do not replace actor failures or add game input.
limitations: The exact historical BattleRuntimeError cause remains unknown.
The existing same-battler move-replacement heuristic is not exact PP-execution proof.
Off-slot move learning changes PP and is currently rejected by the strict vector guard; extended-training qualification remains open.
A semantic effect is not necessarily a fully settled next decision boundary.
The prospective cartridge runner must bind and verify durable diagnostic storage.
Synthetic timing coverage does not establish cartridge or learned reliability.
